push.body:
Ten. Point. Zero. PhogsToffees, that's a Perfect Game #14 and I'd like it laminated, please.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 14th Perfect Game for us. Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.
+ Key passes 5, up from your usual 1. That's the stuff I want framed.
+ Goal involvements 5, up from your usual 1. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ Man of the Match, your 29th for us. When you play like that, the whole team stands taller.
+ Match rating 10.0, up from your usual 7.2. I see you, and I like what I see.

THE BAD
- 2 of 4 shots on target. Quick fix: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
- 4 missed tackles: -0.1. Room to grow.
- Pass accuracy: 86%. The bar for top forwards is 88%+. Go clear it.

Work on: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

PhogsToffees, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Practice like you're second, play like you're first.

That's the player I knew you were. - Coach Lasso
